result.scope_note: The 1969 Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties is an international agreement between States. Article 1 defines the scope of the Convention. The claim that it applies to treaties between states and private corporations requires verification against the Convention's text and established interpretation.

explanation.text: Article 1 of the 1969 Vienna Convention states the present Convention applies to treaties between States, not private corporations. Source 32e9192a confirms scope is limited to States.

Article 3 explicitly states the Convention does not apply to agreements between States and other subjects of international law, reinforcing that private corporations are outside its scope. Source 6af12665 cites Articles 1 and 3.

The Convention was done at Vienna in 1969; Article 1 restricts applicability to State-to-State treaties, contradicting applicability to private corporations. Source 10b8b0ba cites the opening clause and Article 1.

Article 3 International agreements not within the scope of the present Convention The fact that the present Convention does not apply to international agreements concluded between States and other subjects of international law or between such other subjects of international law, or to international agreements not in written form, shall not affect: 3 (a) the legal force of such agreements; (b) the application to them of any of the rules set forth in the present Convention to which they would be subject under international law independently of the Convention; (c) the application of the Convention to the relations of States as between themselves under international agreements to which other subjects of international law are also parties.

excerpts.text: The VCLT defines a [treaty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Treaty "Treaty") as "an international agreement concluded between [sovereign] states in written form and governed by international law", and affirms that "every state possesses the capacity to conclude treaties." Article 1 of the VCLT restricts the application of the convention to written treaties between states, excluding treaties concluded between the states and international organizations or between international organizations.
